card.name: RE in capitalized RECOMMENDED
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word recommended or recommendation, mostly in all-caps warnings such as NOT RECOMMENDED or DO NOT EXCEED THE RECOMMENDED dose. It also fires on words just before recommendations.

modes.label: Capitalized RE in warnings
modes.description: The RE piece starting RECOMMENDED or RECOMMENDATIONS in all-caps label warnings.
modes.example: DO NOT EXCEED THE<< RE>>COMMENDED DOSE, CONCENTRATION

modes.label: Inside lowercase recommended
modes.description: The m piece partway through a lowercase, oddly split reco-m-mended.
modes.example: the reco<< m>>men ded daily dose is 75

modes.label: Verb before recommendations
modes.description: A verb such as made right before the word recommendations in ordinary prose.
modes.example: who then<< made>> recommendations to UK Ministers on which Sites should

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the letters rec, spelling out recommend and related words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say or spell out the word recommended, especially in capitalized warnings.
